newsitem.title: USA: Standard Management to buy Savers Life.
newsitem.headline: Standard Management to buy Savers Life.

text.p: Standard Management Corp said it entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Winston-Salem, N.C.-based Savers Life Insurance Co for about $14.2 million.
Shareholders of Savers will get $8.00 for each share of Savers common stock, consisting of Standard stock and an election of up to $2 per share in cash, Standard said.
The proposed acquisition is subject to certain conditions including SMC and Savers shareholder approval and approval by applicable regulatory authorities, Standard said.
Standard is an Indianapolis financial services company.
